decision.detail: I stand. Coat off the back of the chair, over my shoulders, buttons to the third. I walk past the coffee table, past the coat-check desk where the envelope sits. I don't touch it. I don't look at it. I go out the lobby door. The November air hits my face. The terminal lot is grey. The coach is there, engine already ticking, driver smoking. I climb the steps. I put my ticket on the shelf above the seat. I sit. The door shuts. The bus pulls out.
decision.intention: Be on the bus when it moves. Be in Pittsburgh by ten. Be at my sister's door by noon. Short hall, by the kitchen. The couch faces the window. Move it. That's the afternoon.
